mapper.select: SELECT * FROM alert_rules WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rule_code='EXPORT_TASK_SYSTEM_FAILURE'
SELECT * FROM alert_rules WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rule_code='EXPORT_TASK_SYSTEM_FAILURE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM alert_events WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_events SET version=version+1 ,status='ACKNOWLEDGED',acknowledged_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ,status='RESOLVED',open_slot=NULL,resolved_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND open_slot=1
mapper.select: SELECT id,actor_user_id,action_type,note,created_at FROM alert_actions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND event_id=#{eventId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT id,event_id,title,message,read_at,created_at FROM alert_notifications WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recipient_user_id=#{userId} AND status='DELIVERED' ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT id FROM alert_notifications WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recipient_user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id} AND status='DELIVERED'
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_notifications SET read_at=COALESCE(read_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recipient_user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id} AND status='DELIVERED'
mapper.select: SELECT e.* FROM alert_events e JOIN alert_rules r ON r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND r.id=e.rule_id WHERE r.enabled=1 AND e.open_slot=1 AND e.recovery_status='UNVERIFIED' AND e.last_seen_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-r.window_seconds,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_export_tasks f WHERE f.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND f.status='FAILED' AND f.error_code=e.error_code AND f.finished_at >= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-r.window_seconds,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_export_tasks s WHERE s.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND s.status='SUCCEEDED' AND s.finished_at > e.last_seen_at) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants t JOIN tenant_memberships m ON m.tenant_id=t.id JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id JOIN tenant_member_roles mr ON mr.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND mr.membership_id=m.id JOIN roles ar ON ar.id=mr.role_id WHERE t.id=r.tenant_id AND u.id=r.owner_user_id AND t.enabled=1 AND m.enabled=1 AND u.enabled=1 AND ar.role_code='TENANT_ADMIN') ORDER BY e.last_seen_at,e.id LIMIT 100
SELECT id FROM inventory_export_tasks WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='FAILED' AND error_code=#{code} AND finished_at >= #{start} ORDER BY finished_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE
SELECT id FROM inventory_export_tasks WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='SUCCEEDED' AND finished_at > #{after} ORDER BY finished_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_events SET recovery_status='RECOVERED',recovered_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND open_slot=1 AND recovery_status='UNVERIFIED'
